items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I brought Tio Macero in because he knew scores... I told Tio I was paying him myself.

ctx.x: In other words, even when the leader is somebody as strong as you are, if you can't counter effectively an A&R man who acts like that --
No. I brought Tio Macero in because he knew scores, every score, and he don't have influence on . He couldn't work with him. I told Tio I was paying him myself.
Yeah. Couldn't you complain to Nessely?
